author: AstroPizza
body:
Me Buster and lumberjack wanted to go back to the old days... Simple maps with great gameplay. Which is why we turned to G_Skippy for inspiration , we wanted to continue the trend and so i present you with "Scizor."

[Info]
-4 teams
-20 players max
-5 players per team

[Builders]
-Pizza334
-Buster_U
-RagingLumberjack
 -Special thanks to SweetMango for hosting the server. <3

[Download] http://www.mediafire.com/download/y8552u3w8id49co/Scizor.rar

[YAML] http://pastebin.com/QvKvfFtx

[Album] http://imgur.com/a/uj5Yo#0



If you have any suggestions please let us know below , thanks. <3

You wrote TDM which is:
T: Team
D: Death
M: Match

and the DTM is:
D: Destroy
T: The
M: Monument

If TDM the snipers will be a pain and if its DTM seems a bit too small .-. and would the YML work either way?

replies.author: ImRaging
replies.body: Glad you guys like the map, and thanks for the support! For any who were wondering, you do not spawn with bows. Bows are located in the chests (not the double chests, as pizza explained, they are for the YAML later on...I think) a couple of blocks in front of each team's spawn. I'd also like to add that in these chests, there are only three bows per team (which is 12 bows on the entire map). Since this map has spawns which are close to each other, and the middle circle, players will die a lot quicker. Soon into the game, most of the players who obtained bows will most likely be dead also which causes the bows to be moved around the teams, or fallen off the edge of the map.-Raging
